opportunities_stage_marks.name: opportunities_stage_marks
opportunities_stage_marks.value: ("opportunities"."stage" = 'new') = ("opportunities"."contacted_at" is null) and ("opportunities"."stage" = 'advised') = ("opportunities"."advised_at" is not null)

targets_owner_by_scope.name: targets_owner_by_scope
targets_owner_by_scope.value: case when "targets"."scope" = 'user' then "targets"."owner_id" is not null else "targets"."owner_id" is null end

tool_calls_decided_by.name: tool_calls_decided_by
tool_calls_decided_by.value: "tool_calls"."status" not in ('approved', 'denied') or "tool_calls"."decided_by_id" is not null

users_admin_outside_tree.name: users_admin_outside_tree
users_admin_outside_tree.value: "users"."role" <> 'admin' or ("users"."segment" is null and "users"."manager_id" is null)
